headline: 'Global Big Money' Gathers to Shed Korea Discount… After Holiday, KOSPI 7000: Will Foreigners Change Their Minds?
summary: The Korean government and Korea Exchange are promoting the domestic stock market to attract global capital through Korea Premium Week. Debate continues over whether foreign investors will return after the holiday.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's benchmark stock index. The so-called Korea discount refers to Korean shares trading at lower valuations than peers.
